title: Virtual Compute: support pricing review — support price
content:
## Applicable basis

Virtual Compute support pricing review — Read portfolio discount fraction from the same-customer, same-billing-entity active support holding; if there is none, use zero. Where multiple such support holdings exist, this scope is unavailable until the customer identifies one; this formula applies to a unique matching support holding.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for support pricing review — support price?**

Read portfolio discount fraction from the same-customer, same-billing-entity active support holding; if there is none, use zero. Where multiple such support holdings exist, this scope is unavailable until the customer identifies one; this formula applies to a unique matching support holding.

## Contract reference authority

Read the same-entity active support tier numerical commercial parameter for this calculation; do not write support.
